19/5/22
Translation of a circular which is being distributed
amongst Koreans in Shanghai.

Declaration of the preparatory committee for a
National Convention.

Only four years ago we began our independence
movement. Although no previous pronouncement had
been made when independence was proclaimed amidst the
"Mansais" of a few of our fellow countrymen, the cry
was taken up and re-echoed throughout Korea.
This is an outward expression of the spirit of freedom
which has been passed from one generation to another
of Koreans for more than four thousand years, and
which has manifested itself in an unprecedented way
during the past ten years. Our independence
movement was started in Spring when the plants begin to
grow. We must be prepared to make many sacrifices
and lose many lives to bring our movement to a
successful issue. Although a few heroes made the
enemy uncomfortable in Korean and killed several
thousands of his soldiers in Chentao, Manchuria, they
were never properly organized and never acted under
one commander. The different revolutionary parties
could not agree to form a national organization, but
each followed its own ideas. The spirit of the
population was consequently broken, and the soldiers
forced to seek refuge in the deserts of Siberia.
Fellow country-men ! The fate of a country
depends upon the determination of its whole population.
The cry of "Mansai" is the expression of our idea
but it must be fortified by a national organization
which will carry on the movement. The necessity
for this organization as the only weapon to further
our independence movement is now realized on all sides.
The fate of Korea depends upon the formation of a
national organization.
Some of our leaders have advocated a national
convention to establish this organization, and the
suggestion has been supported by Korean societies
in America, Mexico, Honolulu, Shanghai, Peking, and
Chentao. Prominent Koreans and many organizations
in all these different places and countries sent us
letters favouring the "National Convention".
Therefore we can assure you that the convention has
the approval of all Koreans.
We, the committee, are now preparing to call a
national convention to settle internal troubles and
pave the way for a united effort in the cause of
independence which is desired by the whole population
of Korea.
We very much regret that we could not call the
convention a year ago when we were appointed but we
promise that that the matter will not be delayed much
further.
Issued May 10, 1922 by the Preparatory Committee
of National Convention.

Committees:-
Kang Ku Wu 姜九禹 Kim Chul 金澈
Nam Hyung Wu 南亨祜 Li Dak 李鐸

正在上海朝鲜人中分发的一份通告的译文。

国民大会筹备委员会宣言。

就在四年前，我们开始了独立运动。虽然在宣布独立时，仅有少数同胞高呼“万岁”，此前并未有任何正式声明，但这一呼声随即在整个朝鲜得到响应和回荡。这是四千多年来代代相传的朝鲜人自由精神的外在表达，并在过去十年中以前所未有的方式显现出来。我们的独立运动始于万物生长的春季。为了使我们运动取得圆满成功，我们必须准备做出许多牺牲，付出许多生命。虽然有几位英雄在朝鲜境内使敌人感到不安，并在满洲的间岛（Chentao）杀死了敌军数千人，但他们从未得到妥善组织，也从未在一位指挥官的统一行动下作战。各革命政党无法就组建全国性组织达成一致，而是各自为政。因此，民众的士气受挫，士兵被迫逃往西伯利亚的荒漠寻求庇护。同胞们！一个国家的命运取决于其全体人民的决心。“万岁”的呼声是我们思想的表达，但必须由一个能够持续开展运动的全国性组织来加以巩固。各方现已认识到，该组织作为推进我们独立运动的唯一武器，其必要性不言而喻。朝鲜的命运取决于全国性组织的建立。
我们的一些领导人主张召开国民大会以建立这一组织，该建议得到了美国、墨西哥、檀香山、上海、北京和间岛（Chentao）的朝鲜社团的支持。所有这些不同地方和国家的知名朝鲜人士及许多组织均致函我们，表示支持“国民大会”。因此，我们可以向你们保证，此次大会已获得全体朝鲜人的认可。
本委员会目前正在筹备召开国民大会，以解决内部纷争，并为全体朝鲜人民所渴望的独立事业中的联合努力铺平道路。
我们深感遗憾，未能在一年前受命之时即召开大会，但我们承诺此事不会再拖延太久。
由国民大会筹备委员会于1922年5月10日发布。

委员：
Kang Ku Wu 姜九禹 Kim Chul 金澈
Nam Hyung Wu 南亨祜 Li Dak 李鐸
Song Byung Zo 宋秉祚 One Se Hoon 安世勳
